title: The Twelve, Transfiguration, and Cost of Discipleship

questions.question: When Jesus called the twelve together and sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal, what did He give them?
options: Power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases
Swords and wooden protective staffs
Gold and silver for their long mission
Scrolls containing the prophets' teachings
questions.correctAnswer: Power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases
questions.explanation: Luke 9:1 (ESV): "And he called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases,"

questions.question: Before the feeding of the five thousand, what was the situation regarding food for the crowd?
options: They had no more than five loaves and two fish
They had gathered a large feast from the surrounding villages
They only had seven loaves and a few small fish
They had exactly twelve baskets of bread ready
questions.correctAnswer: They had no more than five loaves and two fish
questions.explanation: Luke 9:13 (ESV): "But he said to them, 'You give them something to eat.' They said, 'We have no more than five loaves and two fish—unless we are to go and buy food for all these people.'"

questions.question: About how many men were there when Jesus fed the multitude at Bethsaida?
options: About five thousand
About four thousand
About ten thousand
About twelve thousand
questions.explanation: Luke 9:14 (ESV): "For there were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, 'Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.'"

questions.question: When Jesus was praying alone and the disciples were with Him, He asked, "Who do the crowds say that I am?" and then, "But who do you say that I am?" Who answered, "The Christ of God"?
options: Peter
John
James
Andrew
questions.explanation: Luke 9:20 (ESV): "Then he said to them, 'But who do you say that I am?' And Peter answered, 'The Christ of God.'"

questions.question: Jesus said to all, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross..." when?
options: Daily and follow me
In times of persecution entirely
When traveling to Jerusalem
At the end of the age
questions.explanation: Luke 9:23 (ESV): "And he said to all, 'If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.'"

questions.question: About eight days after saying these sayings, Jesus took Peter, John, and James up on the mountain to pray. What happened to His appearance?
options: The appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became dazzling white
His face shone like the sun entirely
He became invisible to them
He was crowned with thorns in a vision
questions.correctAnswer: The appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became dazzling white
questions.explanation: Luke 9:29 (ESV): "And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became dazzling white."

questions.question: Moses and Elijah appeared in glory and spoke with Jesus. What specifically were they speaking about?
options: His departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem
The destruction of the temple
The law given upon Mount Sinai
The plagues of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: His departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Luke 9:31 (ESV): "who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem."

questions.question: When Peter saw Moses and Elijah parting from Him, he suggested making three tents. What did a voice from the cloud say?
options: "This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!"
"This is my beloved Son; listen to him!"
"These are my prophets, and this is my Son."
"He alone holds the words of life."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!"
questions.explanation: Luke 9:35 (ESV): "And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, 'This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!'"

questions.question: The next day, a man begged Jesus to look at his son, his only child, who was seized by a spirit. Why did the man not ask the disciples to cast it out?
options: He begged the disciples to cast it out, but they could not
They were not present when he arrived
The scribes told him not to trust the disciples
He only wanted the master to do it
questions.correctAnswer: He begged the disciples to cast it out, but they could not
questions.explanation: Luke 9:40 (ESV): "And I begged your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."

questions.question: How did Jesus react when He heard the disciples could not cast out the demon from the boy?
options: "O faithless and twisted generation, how long am I to be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."
"Have you not prayed and fasted enough?"
"Because this sort of demon is too powerful for you."
"I am tired, and the day is long. Let him heal later."
questions.correctAnswer: "O faithless and twisted generation, how long am I to be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."
questions.explanation: Luke 9:41 (ESV): "Jesus answered, 'O faithless and twisted generation, how long am I to be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.'"

questions.question: When an argument arose among the disciples as to which of them was the greatest, what did Jesus do?
options: He took a child and put him by his side
He gave them a parable about vineyard workers
He brought a servant to wash their feet
He pointed to the sky and rebuked them
questions.correctAnswer: He took a child and put him by his side
questions.explanation: Luke 9:47 (ESV): "But Jesus, knowing the reasoning of their hearts, took a child and put him by his side"

questions.question: When the days drew near for Him to be taken up, Jesus sent messengers ahead into a village of the Samaritans to make preparations. Why did the Samaritans not receive Him?
options: Because his face was set toward Jerusalem
Because he was a known Jewish rabbi
Because he refused to worship on Mount Gerizim
Because James and John threatened them
questions.correctAnswer: Because his face was set toward Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Luke 9:53 (ESV): "But the people did not receive him, because his face was set toward Jerusalem."

questions.question: When the Samaritans rejected them, James and John asked, "Lord, do you want us to tell fire to come down from heaven and consume them?" What did Jesus do?
options: He turned and rebuked them
He agreed and a village was destroyed
He said "Yes, for Elijah did so"
He wept for the mercy of the Samaritans
questions.explanation: Luke 9:55 (ESV): "But he turned and rebuked them." (Some manuscripts add: "You do not know what manner of spirit you are of...")

questions.question: As they were going along the road, someone said, "I will follow you wherever you go." What did Jesus say about foxes and birds?
options: "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
"They find rest, but the disciples of God must work continuously."
"Foxes have holes, but you will have mansions prepared in heaven."
"Birds of the air have nests, but you must make the world your home."
questions.correctAnswer: "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
questions.explanation: Luke 9:58 (ESV): "And Jesus said to him, 'Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.'"

questions.question: When a man said, "I will follow you, Lord, but let me first say farewell to those at my home," what proverb-like statement did Jesus reply with?
options: "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
"A man cannot serve two masters simultaneously."
"The dead must bury their own dead without ceasing."
"Let the farewell be brief, for the laborers are few."
questions.correctAnswer: "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
questions.explanation: Luke 9:62 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.'"

key_verse_text: And he said to all, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me."
